verdict.rationale: Shopify's official Admin API docs claim broad programmatic control over the store — creating apps/integrations, GraphQL mutations via GraphiQL, scoped OAuth tokens — which implies product/order management (shopify-docs-31, shopify-docs-18, shopify-docs-5, shopify-docs-x3). However, a hands-on developer report explicitly states 'Want to do refunds? Too bad there's no way to do it via the API' (shopify-comm-9), directly contradicting one of the four capabilities named in the story, while other complaints describe partner-support friction and API design pain (shopify-comm-8, shopify-comm-12). Missing for 10: explicit docs/examples for refund-issuing and fulfillment-triggering mutations, and independent confirmation resolving the refund-API dispute.
